newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to stronger despite crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to stronger despite crude.

text.p: NWE oil products were all steady to firmer, despite softer crude.
Gas oil firmed $1.25 a tonne on futures. Cargo premiums were steady to slightly firmer in quiet trade. Barge premiums were around unchanged.
Gasoline was firmer, supported by a scarcity of ARA refinery product and an open U.S. arb. Eurograde barges traded at $214.50 and $215 fob ARA.
Naphtha was steady with cargoes pegged at $224/$225.
High sulphur barges were a couple of dollars firmer, but cargoes were unchanged. Russian material was still available.
